blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Arellano has found little reason to celebrate despite its surprising start in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament. The Chiefs improved to 3-0 in Group B after an 88-65 victory over Perpetual Help at Philsports Arena on Friday. Still, the unbeaten start has hardly put them in a celebratory mood. King Vinoya, who spearheaded Arellano’s third straight win with 15 points, would rather focus on what lies ahead for the Chiefs. “We don’t think much about those things.
